consequence.statement: Existing PolicyException objects stay stored as v2beta1 until rewritten; a storage version migration must be run and status.storedVersions updated before a later release removes v2beta1.
consequence.remediation: Re-write all PolicyException objects (storage version migration) and update status.storedVersions on the CRD.

assertion.statement: The storage version of the policyexceptions.kyverno.io CRD changes from v2beta1 to v2, so existing PolicyException objects stay stored as v2beta1 until a storage version migration rewrites them and status.storedVersions is updated.
